dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual convex 2D narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle, resulting in a sharp triangular termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and symmetrical with no visible structural bulges or indentations.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small specular highlights localized near the blowhole; no visible lesions or rake marks.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Prominent, elevated linear ridge along the central dorsal axis, characterized by a light-colored contrast against the dark-grey background.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct light-colored dorsal ridge extending from the mid-back toward the posterior.
